baseline.model: homogeneous isotropic selected radial sphere mode and passive one-mode receptance

exactQuestion: Under this fixed finite model and calibration likelihood, are logE/logrho/logcombinedgain identifiable with the declared precision, and can the specified sampled gain slopes/delays be rejected by held-out response data?

observableMap.frequencySelection: Fixed absolute commands before data, independent of estimated pole
observableMap.stressInterpretation: Separate slope or delay, never an unspecified arbitrary gain family

sharedNoiseModel.responseNoise: Circular complex Gaussian: each real/imag SD=abs(Y)*10^(-SNR/20)/sqrt(2); synthetic variances known to benchmark likelihood
sharedNoiseModel.clock: b~N(0,(10e-6)^2), truncated at±5SD, common to whole record
sharedNoiseModel.conditionalIndependence: Other measurement errors independent Gaussian conditional on shared clock; geometry, gain and phase effects are common through the forward model
sharedNoiseModel.phaseConvention: Fit phi on(-pi,pi]; use circular differences and identify equivalent phases; do not select a branch from known simulation truth
sharedNoiseModel.reuseRule: Any later reuse of a pole/reference estimate requires its joint covariance; otherwise abstain
sharedNoiseModel.dampingStatus: fixed exact0.002; uncertainty in damping outside this benchmark

calibrationBudgets.status: Frozen synthetic design choices; no empirical instrument capability asserted

conditioning.construction: Real-stack complex and calibration observations; whiten declared joint observation covariance; project target Jacobian off whitened nuisance columns including calibration constraints; then apply target column scales.
conditioning.warning: Re-derive at fixed absolute frequencies; Plan1 fixed-normalized-frequency response row is not valid unchanged.

acceptance.bootstrapSeeds: Independent of record-generation stream; manifest frozen before implementation
acceptance.failurePolicy: Abstain or downgrade failed scenario; no threshold tuning or exclusions derived from fit success

positiveControls: N1–N5 known-parameter recovery under correct model
Calibrated mass breaks the declared common material/gain scale ambiguity
decisiveCountercontrols: Uncalibrated common(E,rho,g) scaling retains a kernel
Duplicate channels add no independent rank
Zero excitation cannot yield a valid calibrated response
A nonconstant gain matching every sampled gain value is not detected
Phase wrapping is an equivalence, not a distinct physical parameter claim
Misdeclared independent pole/response noise must fail covariance review
abstention: Boundary or nonunique fit, unresolved phase branch, or unknown covariance
Model differs from declared homogeneous isolated mode or damping
remainingPreExecutionGates: Freeze exact likelihood, interval construction, residual statistic and seed manifest before writing/running implementation
Independent methods review approves fixed-frequency Jacobian, joint covariance and nuisance profiling
Skeptic freezes deterministic wrong/positive controls before viewing outputs
Existing Node and NumPy/SciPy source/dependency versions bound in execution manifest

resources.bootstrapAccounting: Likelihood draws, not extra acquisition records; included in compute cap
resources.hardware: No instrument access assumed or admitted

independentReview.methods: Algebra, covariance, normalization and numerical conditioning
independentReview.skeptic: Frozen wrong controls, honest abstention, coverage and gain-family limitation

dependentA2.releaseGate: A1 accepted scenarios and a separately frozen future pole/support/omitted-mode contract
dependentA2.nonClaim: No intrinsic-location law; classification under a declared finite model only

stopRule: Stop on unresolved covariance/likelihood, structural ambiguity, failed reference controls or resource cap. Preserve failed scenarios. This closes final planning; no third round or implementation is authorized by this document.
limits: No arbitrary-function gain detection from finite data
